items.t: 12-volt battery drains and the car won't wake up
items.job: Software update, and 12-volt battery replacement if it has been drained repeatedly
items.note: The software fix itself is usually done under warranty. The price shown is for a new 12-volt battery, installed and registered.

items.t: Tires wear out fast or car pulls to one side

items.note: Price is for a full set of tires with mounting; an alignment check is included in the hours.
